resolved_findings.issue: Whole-record hashes embedded in right-node/mesh/material metadata could change the sibling closure during a left-only edit.
resolved_findings.resolution: SPECIFICATION section 9 forbids whole-record or source/dependency hashes in per-object data; the detached envelope carries them. No new sibling-normalization exemption was introduced.

resolved_findings.issue: The initial validation draft did not fully fix geometric welding, topology/volume arithmetic or the required finding sets when one corruption violates several checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: VALIDATION sections 3 and 5 now fix measured-corner buckets at delta=0.000005 m, representative selection, twelve outward triangles/six faces/edge incidence, exact-rational signed volume and its allowance, clearance/overlap formulas and aggregated D01 CLEARANCE / D03 SIBLING requirements.

resolved_findings.issue: P03 could be read as accepting noncanonical serialized record key order.
resolved_findings.resolution: CONTROLS P03 now permutes frontend dictionary insertion order before mandatory canonical serialization; unsorted serialized canonical records still fail.

resolved_findings.issue: Mandatory cleanup had to precede accepted-pointer promotion to guarantee that cleanup failures preserve the predecessor.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final amendment 2205f49e1c3ff0dbb8d35e492a29df52f56ea215 requires reaped children, closed output handles and successful mandatory cleanup before accepted-pointer compare-and-swap in SPECIFICATION section 10 and VALIDATION section 7.
